summary: All 12 files in the Bochner theorem formalization contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, lemmas, and proofs — directly relevant to the corpus. None are pure import aggregators, boilerplate, or duplicates. The files collectively implement Bochner's theorem and its variants (on finite-dimensional spaces, discrete groups, locally compact abelian groups, characteristic-function form, Herglotz's theorem on ℤ), along with the supporting machinery: Fourier convention conversions, nonnegativity of the Fourier transform via Fejér averaging, Gaussian positive-definiteness and regularization, and the Bochner representing measure. Every file declares public mathematical API and proves nontrivial results. Per FILTER-002/004/007/021/025, the default retain disposition applies; no file meets the high evidence bar for hard exclusion.
